products.name: DrumGirth
products.tagline: Kit generator + 16-pad sampler: warped loops, live loop sync, kit brain, analog-style FX, 16 outs.
products.notes:
DrumGirth 0.5.0
- LOOP WARP (per pad): Warp = loops time-stretch to the song tempo with pitch kept (Ableton-style
  phase-vocoder stretch, Signalsmith Stretch). Pitch knob on a warped loop transposes without
  changing length or tempo. Re-Pitch = old speed-up/slow-down. Off = raw file.
- LOOP SPEED (under Loop Warp): Quarter / Half Time / Normal / Double / 4x against the song tempo.
- Drag samples from Ableton's browser or Finder onto any pad (dropped sounds auto-LOCK so NEW KIT keeps them).
- Loops become loop cells automatically (loop names, BPM in the name, or 2.5 s+ sounds). "RW1_172_x" reads as 172 BPM.
- Loop hits while Live plays restart from the top snapped to the 1/16 grid, so late hits stay in time.
- REVERSE now works on loop cells.
- COMP knob on every pad (one-knob compressor with auto make-up).
- AUTO MIX (next to NEW KIT, on by default): new kits come pre-mixed per pad - light comp, low-cut on everything
  but kicks/808s, a little punch on kicks/snares, hats and percs panned a little. No reverb or delay sends.
  Genre sets the amounts (trap gets a driven 808, lo-fi/boom bap get SP-12 crunch).
- Decay, Pitch, Pitch Env and P.Env Time now work on loop cells (Re-Pitch mode: Pitch = record speed).
- LOOP IN / LOOP OUT follow your drags live while the loop plays - no re-hit, no stopping the transport.
  Trimming never changes the loop's tempo. REVERSE flips live too.
- Loops are GATED by default when they load into a loop cell: play while held, stop on release.
- FASTER OPEN: the sample library loads in the background instead of before the window opens.
- Library analysis saves its progress every minute, so closing Live no longer restarts it from zero.
- Ear training runs off to the side - the window never freezes waiting on it.
- New logo: flaming snare, no mushrooms.
- LOOP SYNC (header): live looping grid - Off / 1/16 / 1/8 / Beat / Bar. Loop hits snap to the grid: late hits start
  as if they were on the line, early hits wait for it. Playing loops are phase-locked to Live's clock and pulled
  back in line if they drift.
- Drag and drop works from more places: file drags, file-link text, and file promises (Splice, browsers, Photos).
- Tempo changes re-warp automatically; a playing loop swaps to the new audio without restarting.
- TRIGGER (per pad): Retrig (default) = hitting a pad again restarts it, no stacking.
  Poly = hits layer. Toggle = loop cells start on one hit, stop on the next (old behavior).
- GATE now works on loop cells too (plays while held). Stopping the transport stops all loops.

DrumGirth 0.4.0
- Shows up in Live as PHANTOMWAVS (was KillWill)
- FOLLOW MIDI: the edit panel jumps to whatever pad you play from your keyboard / pads / clips
- WAVE EDITOR per pad: see the sample, drag START / END to trim, blue dots set fade in / fade out,
  envelope line shows decay, live playhead, scroll to zoom, SNAP to transients (hold Shift to skip snapping)
- Loop cells: START / END set the loop region (stays in sync with your tempo)
- THE EAR: every hit gets a 17-point sound fingerprint (8 frequency bands, brightness, noisiness, attack, decay,
  sub, punch, grit). It learns what each genre sounds like - per drum type - from the packs in your library
  that are named by genre, then hears the genre of every unnamed sample. Genre picks in NEW KIT now use it,
  and each pad shows what the Ear hears ("Ear: Trap 64%  Drill 20%")
